items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: When Emerson Brown was starting to falter a bit, up steps Bill Semple and I get this guy.

ctx.x: Do you see replacements in line for the All-Stars?
I don’t. But you never can tell. Now Bill Semple is the class of ’68. When Emerson Brown was starting to falter a bit, up steps Bill Semple and I get this guy. And he’s a guy
from ’68 replacing a guy from ’56. So it’s always possible. I hope they will, I hope they’ll find them.
